Sprechen Sie mit den Landwirten und dann lernen Sie etwas dazu!

paragraphs.text: Vážená pani predsedajúca. Pán komisár, v prvom rade ďakujem veľmi pekne za predstavenie návrhu. Oceňujem veľmi vysoko, že ste sa poponáhľali a že napriek tomu, že ste hovorili, že to bude v júni, ste predstavili už v máji tento návrh. Aj to hovorí o tom, aká je vážna táto situácia s hnojivami v Európskej únii. Potrebujeme hnojivá, aby sme mali potraviny v Európskej únii.

Páči sa mi návrh, že chcete zvýšiť poľnohospodársku rezervu a financie pre poľnohospodárov a verím, že spoločne sa nám podarí aj do budúcej poľnohospodárskej politiky v ďalšom období získať viac peňazí, aby poľnohospodári mali aspoň nejakú istotu. Návrh na využitie digestátu považujem za veľmi správny. Napríklad v prípade Slovenskej republiky si vieme určite predstaviť používanie takéhoto hnojiva, pretože máme bioplynové elektrárne, ktoré vedia niečo takéto vyrobiť. Väčšie využívanie organického odpadu: predpokladám a dúfam, že tým myslíte aj väčšiu podporu odpadu z maštalí a z rôznych – vlastne – priestorov, kde sa chová rôzny typ dobytka alebo zvierat, takže to určite môže byť veľmi dobrý nápad takisto. Navrhovala by som zrušenie zákazu dovozu hnojív z Ruska a z Bieloruska alebo minimálne tých častí, ktoré potrebujeme pre hnojivá a tých prvkov, ktoré nemáme v Európskej únii. Kolegovia hovorili o ekologickom hnojení. Ja si myslím, že to je veľmi dobrý nápad. Avšak ekologické znamená, že je nižšia výťažnosť, menej sa vyrobí a máme tam väčšiu náročnosť na vyrobenie takýchto potravín a takých hnojív. Takže možno to nie je riešenie, ale uvidíme, čo Európska komisia urobí s implementáciou.

paragraphs.text: Fru talman! Kommissionär Hansen. Återigen står våra bönder inför stora utmaningar. Omvärldsläget med konflikten i Mellanöstern har lett till ett allvarligt läge med skenande kostnader för både gödsel och diesel. Det hotar vår livsmedelsförsörjning, vår livsmedelssäkerhet och våra lantbrukares framtid och den europeiska konkurrenskraften.

Den situation vi befinner oss nu, den är allvarlig och riskerar också att få långtgående konsekvenser om vi inte agerar nu. Kortsiktigt behövs stöd som säkerställer att våra lantbrukare kan fortsätta att producera mat utan att straffas och själva bära den ekonomiska bördan. Det är bra med en action plan, men vi behöver också långsiktighet. Vi måste se till att skapa incitament för att minska EU:s importberoende av gödsel, och i stället bli mer självförsörjande och kunna producera mer inom den europeiska marknaden.

I dag saknas det fungerande alternativ för gödsel och för stora delar av jordbruket är inte det här varken hållbart eller långsiktigt. Därför att man har inga andra alternativ. Många jordbrukare frågar sig i dag om det är värt att fortsätta. Vi måste ifrån det här huset se till att det finns hopp för europeiska och svenska jordbrukare att fortsätta att odla mat.

political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, cher Commissaire, votre plan d'action sur les engrais répond en partie aux difficultés de nos agriculteurs. Toutefois, que de temps perdu depuis le 28 février dernier, début de la guerre sur le détroit d'Ormuz. Face à des prix des céréales en berne, ils avaient besoin d'un signal fort pour compenser l'augmentation des prix des engrais et des carburants. J'ai écouté avec attention votre discours. Je n'ai entendu aucun chiffre.

Aimer les agriculteurs, c'est bien. Les preuves d'amour, c'est mieux. Au-delà du court terme, nous devons également augmenter nos capacités de production et de stockage stratégique. La taxe carbone aux frontières doit nous y aider, mais nous devons étudier d'ores et déjà sa suspension pour une année, le temps d'être dans une meilleure position.

Le plan d'action contient d'autres propositions pertinentes, comme la diplomatie commerciale et le recours à l’agroécologie, aux légumineuses et au digestat. Pour autant, il passe à côté d'un point essentiel: comment nos agriculteurs pourront-ils supporter l'effet des quotas carbone sur le long terme si on les laisse exposés à une concurrence déloyale? C'est pour cela que nous devons augmenter aussi le niveau des prix d'intervention de la PAC.

paragraphs.text: Elnök Asszony! Ha van gazdasági ágazat, amelyet több oldalról is sanyargat a mostani energiaválság, akkor az a mezőgazdaság. Az, hogy mind az olajárak, mind a gázárak jóval magasabbak a háború előtti szinthez képest, önmagában is durván növeli a termelési költségeket. De nem csak a mezőgazdasági gépekbe töltött üzemanyag ára szállt el, hanem a műtrágyáé is, átlagosan 50%-kal a válság előtti szinthez képest. Súlyosbító körülmény, hogy a kőolajjal ellentétben itt nincsenek stratégiai készletek.

A Bizottság korábban plusz adókat vetett ki a műtrágyaimportra. Tudomásunk szerint a ma bemutatott akciótervben ezt nem fogják visszavonni. Lehetővé teszik viszont, hogy az egyes tagállamok 50%-os támogatást nyújthassanak a gázolaj- és műtrágyaköltségekre. Nagyon reméljük, hogy az új magyar kormány is él majd ezzel a lehetőséggel. Ez az ügy nem csak a mezőgazdasági ágazatot érinti. Az élelmiszerek ára a tét, minden család asztalára kerülő élelmiszerek ára, és hogyha nem történnek gyors lépések, akkor az élelmiszer-infláció ránk dönti az ajtót, és sokkal súlyosabb lesz, mint amit eddig bármikor láttunk.

paragraphs.text: Doamnă președintă, noua strategie UE pentru fertilizatori nu trebuie să fie doar o listă de bune intenții, ci un plan de securitate națională și europeană.

Traversăm o criză sistemică pe care, din păcate, am mai trăit-o. Declanșarea războiului din Ucraina a expus dureros dependența noastră toxică de materii prime, precum potasiul, provenite din state ca Rusia sau Belarus. Cu toate acestea, pare că nu am învățat nimic.

Astăzi, fermierii noștri sunt sufocați de importuri masive, de prețuri record și de speculă pe piața internațională. Datele oficiale din analiză ne arată clar: vulnerabilitatea noastră structurală crește de la o lună la alta.

Nu putem vorbi despre suveranitatea alimentară fără suveranitate în producția de fertilizatori. Soluția pe termen lung nu este subvenționarea dependenței, ci recâștigarea autonomiei strategice a Europei.

Trebuie să sprijinim urgent deschiderea și redeschiderea combinatelor de fertilizatori pe teritoriul Uniunii. Aceasta nu este doar o problemă agricolă; producția de fertilizatori ține direct de securitatea geopolitică a Uniunii Europene.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, Commissioner, you know as well as any of us the pressure farmers are presently under. Many of the measures mentioned in this strategy are necessary. They're timely and forward looking. I commend you for them. But there is unfortunately a clear omission, and it goes to the heart of whether this strategy is serious about relieving the pressures farmers face today.

The Strait of Hormuz has been closed for nearly 12 weeks with no sign of reopening. The UN Food and Agriculture Organization has repeatedly warned of the consequences for farmers, for food supply and for prices. We are staring down the barrel of a crisis. And yet, this strategy says nothing about easing CBAM on fertilisers, even at the 1 % rate in comparison to 10, 20 and 30 % for other sectors or other products. It is not just a missed opportunity, Commissioner. It is one measure that would make the difference right now and that is unfortunately absent.

I would use this opportunity as well to call on my own government in Ireland to make use of the measures mentioned and available on the aid schemes under the temporary framework, and to mobilise CAP to get advance payments moving to farmers who cannot, unfortunately, wait as this crisis worsens. We need – and we all need – to act as fast as possible.

The Strait of Hormuz has been closed for nearly 12 weeks with no sign of reopening. The UN Food and Agriculture Organization has repeatedly warned of the consequences for farmers, for food supply and for prices. We are staring down the barrel of a crisis. And yet, this strategy says nothing about easing CBAM on fertilisers, even at the 1 % rate in comparison to 10, 20 and 30 % for other sectors or other products. It is not just a missed opportunity, Commissioner. It is one measure that would make the difference right now and that is unfortunately absent.

I would use this opportunity as well to call on my own government in Ireland to make use of the measures mentioned and available on the aid schemes under the temporary framework, and to mobilise CAP to get advance payments moving to farmers who cannot, unfortunately, wait as this crisis worsens. We need – and we all need – to act as fast as possible.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, Monsieur le Commissaire, vous venez aujourd’hui nous présenter un plan d’action pour les engrais dont le prix explose. Mais derrière les enjeux des coûts se cache une réalité brutale: nous avons laissé le poison entrer dans notre alimentation. Ce poison, c’est le cadmium. Il vient justement des engrais qui s’accumulent dans les sols, s’infiltrent dans les cultures et atterrissent dans notre pain, nos céréales, nos pommes de terre. En France, la contamination a presque doublé en dix ans. Les adultes sont exposés, les enfants sont exposés.

En 2019, l’Europe a décidé de réduire le recours à ces engrais toxiques. Mais avec combien d’exceptions? Les États membres peuvent aujourd’hui librement décider d’importer de n’importe où des engrais pleins de cadmium sans date butoir. La France veut d’ailleurs attendre encore douze ans avant de se libérer de ce poison. Va-t-on la laisser faire?

Monsieur le Commissaire, votre plan d’action ne peut pas être seulement un plan pour faire baisser les prix des engrais chimiques. Il doit être aussi un plan de santé publique, de protection des sols, de protection de nos enfants. Alors, n’attendons plus que d’autres vies soient gâchées et agissons sans plus tarder.

paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin, Herr Kommissar, meine Damen und Herren! Unsere Nahrungsmittelsouveränität ist wichtiger denn je. Es gilt also, unsere heimische Produktion zu steigern. Doch wie soll das funktionieren, wenn Düngemittel unbezahlbar werden durch weltweit einmalig hohe Energiekosten, durch Kostentreiber wie CBAM, durch unrealistische Umweltauflagen? Das bringt unsere Betriebe an die Existenzgrenze, viele Landwirte müssen aufgeben.

Wie soll unsere chemische Industrie mehr Ammoniak herstellen, wenn sie wegen EU-Auflagen gezwungen wird, in Drittländer abzuwandern? Wenn die Kommission nun Mittel aus dem Notfallfonds bereitstellt, ist das eine kurzfristige, gute Hilfe. Wichtiger wäre es aber, die Ausnahmeregelung in ETS und CBAM zu verlängern. Als Sofortmaßnahme sollte außerdem die Nitrat-Richtlinie endlich überarbeitet werden, damit mehr Gärreste verwendet werden können.

Aber bitte setzen Sie nicht auf Korridore für grünes Ammoniak aus Afrika und dem Nahen Osten, wie zu lesen war. Das sind Wunschträume wie grüner Stahl oder grüner Wasserstoff. Lösen Sie sich von grünen Utopien und erkennen die Wirklichkeit an, denn unsere Bauern dürfen nicht wieder enttäuscht werden.

paragraphs.text: Pani Przewodnicząca! Panie Komisarzu! Ta dzisiejsza debata i ten plan przedstawiony przez Komisję Europejską nie jest tylko i wyłącznie o problemach z dostępnością w przystępnych cenach nawozów dla naszych europejskich rolników czy o dramatycznej sytuacji naszego rodzimego przemysłu nawozowego. To jest debata o tym, że zarówno europejskie rolnictwo, jak i europejski przemysł tracą całkowicie konkurencyjność przez całkowite przeregulowanie systemu, przez to, że tonie on pod ciężarem europejskiej biurokracji.

Dziś coraz trudniej jest prowadzić zarówno działalność gospodarczą, jak i rolniczą. Naprawdę nie potrzebujemy już dzisiaj półśrodków. Potrzebujemy natychmiast zawiesić system ETS, bo to da oddech przemysłowi nawozowemu, jak również dostęp do nawozów w przyzwoitych cenach dla europejskich rolników.

Unia Europejska to najwspanialszy projekt, jaki narodził się tutaj w Europie, ale tracimy go przez technokratów i biurokratów. I żeby było jasne - nie mam tu na myśli pana komisarza Hansena, bo jego uważam za jedną z nielicznych już osób w Komisji Europejskiej, której zależy na tym, żeby coś zmienić. Naprawdę rośnie nam eurosceptycyzm, populizm i nacjonalizm. I jeśli dzisiaj nie staniemy po stronie europejskich rolników i europejskiego przemysłu, to ten najwspanialszy projekt pod nazwą Unia Europejska po prostu przegra.

paragraphs.text: Doamnă președintă, domnule comisar, stimați colegi, industria europeană de îngrășăminte este foarte puternic afectată de prețurile mari la energie și o știm de foarte mult timp. Din această cauză, foarte multe producții de îngrășăminte în Uniunea Europeană s-au închis, așa cum este și Azomureș din țara mea. Din noiembrie 2025 au închis porțile și au plecat oamenii acasă.

Problema este de menținere într-o stare de incertitudine. Trebuie să punem capăt importurilor, da, în loc să încurajăm importurile și să crească producția de îngrășăminte în state terțe, importând și poluare, mai bine încurajăm producția internă de îngrășăminte. Pentru că până la urmă trebuie să tratăm producția de îngrășăminte ca o infrastructură critică europeană. De ea depinde și producția și securitatea alimentară, dar nu putem să prăbușim producția de îngrășăminte din România și din Uniunea Europeană.

Domnule comisar, e nevoie să modificăm Directiva RED III pentru a elimina hidrogenul utilizat pentru fabricarea amoniacului destinat producției de îngrășăminte, deoarece nu se pot îndeplini condițiile. Sunt multe motive, nu am timp să le spun pe toate, dar infrastructura, de exemplu, dedicată transportului hidrogenului, este inexistentă și nu are cum să se întâmple transportul. Infrastructura de transport electricitate nu este dimensionată pentru a asigura necesarul de până la 35 % din energia verde.
Așadar, avem nevoie de o producție de îngrășăminte în Uniunea Europeană pentru agricultură.

paragraphs.text: Señora presidenta, señor comisario, hace justo un año muchos advertimos en esta Cámara que imponer aranceles a los fertilizantes mientras se mantenían los impuestos climáticos iba a disparar enormemente los costes del campo europeo. Y eso es exactamente lo que está ocurriendo hoy, lo hemos visto, el resultado está ahí fuera: cientos de agricultores manifestándose frente a este mismo edificio porque fertilizar hoy su explotación agraria les cuesta un 70 % más que hace tan solo dos años.

El problema no es solamente la guerra. El problema no es solamente la dependencia exterior. El problema es, sobre todo, que Europa ha decidido cargar sobre su propia industria unos costes energéticos y medioambientales que el resto del mundo no tiene. Para que se entienda bien: por cada euro que paga un competidor extranjero en impuestos al CO2, el productor europeo paga quince veces más. Pero, eso sí, después les pedimos que compitan y que vendan al mismo precio. Ustedes le llaman a esto política climática, nosotros lo llamamos suicidio industrial.

Hoy tenían una oportunidad de oro para corregir el rumbo, en cambio este plan llega tarde, sin dinero garantizado y sin afrontar los principales problemas que siguen penalizando nuestra producción. Así que, señor comisario, mientras debatimos aquí Europa pierde la capacidad de alimentarse a sí misma y hay un responsable: ustedes.

paragraphs.text: Gracias por su pregunta, señor Nardella. Usted dice que no tenemos ninguna propuesta.
Yo creo que estamos presentando propuestas constantemente que sí solucionarían todos los problemas que ustedes les crean a nuestros agricultores.

En primer lugar, eliminar el mercado de impuestos al CO2, eliminar el sistema de RCDE, eliminar el CBAM. Porque todo esto son costes —como le he dicho— que tiene que asumir el productor, mientras el resto del mundo no tiene que asumir esos costes. Quince veces —no sé si me ha escuchado: quince veces más— tienen que pagar nuestros productores en comparación con lo que tienen que pagar los productores del extranjero.

Si a usted esto le parece competir libremente, yo creo que debería revisar cómo se compite libremente para que realmente a nuestros productores les pueda ser rentable. Y, por último, lo hemos dicho cientos de veces: eliminar el Pacto Verde Europeo. Si no le parece suficiente propuesta, yo creo que está muy claro.

Tak dawno nie słyszałam tylu propagandowych sformułowań nowomowy europejskiej, która kreśli bliżej nieokreślony, mglisty plan na najbliższe dziesięciolecia, bo nie wybrzmiało tutaj nic konkretnego. paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin! Herr Kommissar! Gunststandorte in Europa bedeuten auch Verantwortung für unsere Ernährungssouveränität. Regionen mit fruchtbaren Böden, ausreichenden Niederschlägen und mit hoher Ertragsfähigkeit müssen wir verantwortungsvoll für die Lebensmittelproduktion nutzen. Uns muss klar sein: Wenn wir keine tragfähige Lösung für die massiv gestiegenen Düngemittelpreise finden, werden Lebensmittel aus der EU deutlich teurer werden. Gerade in geopolitisch unsicheren Zeiten ist eine eigene gesicherte Lebensmittelversorgung von strategischer Bedeutung.

Es ist den europäischen Landwirten auch nicht zu erklären, dass sie immer höhere Anforderungen erfüllen müssen, während gleichzeitig Handelsabkommen wie Mercosur vorläufig in Kraft treten und schon nach zwei Wochen Fragen zur Einhaltung zentraler Produktionsstandards in Brasilien im Raum stehen. Genau deshalb müssen wir die europäische Landwirtschaft stärken, etwa durch wettbewerbsfähige Energiepreise und die gezielte Nutzung verfügbarer Gasmengen für die heimische Düngemittelproduktion und für den Erhalt sowie den Ausbau europäischer Produktionskapazitäten. Denn die Versorgungssicherheit Europas beginnt mit unseren heimischen Landwirten.

paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin, liebe Kolleginnen und Kollegen! Unsere wichtigste Aufgabe muss doch sein, die Abhängigkeit von Lukaschenka, Putin und von den Golfstaaten bei Düngemittelimporten zu verringern. Das ist die zentrale Aufgabe!

Wer jetzt Zollsenkungen fordert oder die Abschaffung von CBAM, der ruiniert letztendlich auch die europäische Düngemittelindustrie, das muss doch klar sein! Wir müssen sie stärken und nicht schwächen! Umstellen – langfristig – bei der Stickstoffproduktion auf erneuerbare Energien kann ein Weg sein.

paragraphs.text: Κυρία Πρόεδρε, συνάδελφοι, οι Ευρωπαίοι αγρότες και καταναλωτές βρίσκονται όλο και περισσότερο αντιμέτωποι με τις συνέπειες του πολέμου στη Μέση Ανατολή. Τον Απρίλιο του 2026, τα αζωτούχα λιπάσματα κόστιζαν 70% περισσότερο σε σύγκριση με το 2024. Αυτό σημαίνει υψηλότερο κόστος παραγωγής για τους αγρότες μας και υψηλότερες τιμές για τους καταναλωτές. Το σχέδιο δράσης για τα λιπάσματα που παρουσιάζεται σήμερα είναι ένα σημαντικό βήμα για να αντιμετωπίσουμε το αυξανόμενο κόστος τους αλλά χρειάζονται ακόμη περισσότερα βήματα.

Βραχυπρόθεσμα, χρειαζόμαστε πιο στοχευμένα ευρωπαϊκά μέτρα στήριξης των αγροτών, με την αξιοποίηση όλων των διαθέσιμων ευρωπαϊκών εργαλείων. Επίσης, τα λιπάσματα συνδέονται άμεσα με την επισιτιστική ασφάλεια και τη δυνατότητα των καταναλωτών να έχουν πρόσβαση σε προσιτά τρόφιμα. Γι’ αυτόν τον λόγο, πρέπει να ενισχύσουμε την εγχώρια παραγωγή και να μειώσουμε την εξάρτησή μας από εισαγωγές. Ωστόσο, χρειαζόμαστε και μια συνολική συζήτηση για τον αντίκτυπο που έχουν νομοθετήματα όπως ο ΜΣΠΑ και το σύστημα ΣΕΔΕ, καθώς και σχεδιασμό για την αντιμετώπιση των πιθανών συνεπειών τους. Τέλος, η Επιτροπή πρέπει να προχωρήσει ακόμη πιο γρήγορα στην υλοποίηση αυτών που συμφωνήθηκαν στο Ευρωπαϊκό Συμβούλιο του Μαρτίου, ώστε να μειωθούν οι τιμές ενέργειας. Δεν πρόκειται για τεχνικά ζητήματα. Είναι ζήτημα ενίσχυσης των αγροτών και μείωσης των τιμών που πληρώνουν οι καταναλωτές.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, la situazione geopolitica in cui ci hanno trascinato le scelte irresponsabili di Trump e Netanyahu sta già presentando il conto agli agricoltori, alle famiglie e alle imprese europee: le tensioni nel Golfo Persico e il blocco dello stretto di Hormuz hanno fatto esplodere i prezzi dei fertilizzanti azotati, necessari per mantenere rese produttive adeguate e garantire sicurezza alimentare.

Di fronte a questo scenario, il piano d'azione che oggi presentate è un primo passo, però da solo non basta: servono risorse vere – dalla mobilitazione della riserva PAC a nuovi ecoschemi e misure ad hoc per lo sviluppo rurale – per sostenere i settori più colpiti e accompagnarli verso un utilizzo più efficiente delle risorse.

E per aumentare la nostra autonomia strategica dobbiamo accelerare sull'utilizzo di fertilizzanti biologici di qualità e "made in Europe", come il digestato, una richiesta che finalmente trova spazio nell'agenda della Commissione.
Come Parlamento siamo pronti a fare la nostra parte, ma servono misure concrete nel più breve tempo possibile per i nostri agricoltori.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, commissaris, collega’s, de crisis inzake kunstmest is een crisis die Europa voor het grootste deel zelf heeft gecreëerd. Onze boeren worden vandaag geconfronteerd met torenhoge kunstmestprijzen, onzekere bevoorrading en een Europese kunstmestindustrie die het steeds moeilijker heeft om het hoofd boven water te houden. Dit komt natuurlijk door een overdaad aan klimaatregels, torenhoge energiekosten en geopolitieke schokken die nooit deftig zijn opgevangen.

En wat doet de Commissie nu? Een actieplan voorstellen met daarin veel mooie woorden en veel mooie beloftes, maar ik zie helaas nul komma nul structurele, concrete maatregelen. Voor mij is dit een gemiste kans. Too little, too late.

Commissaris, er is nood aan echte doortastende maatregelen. Maak het onze kunstmestproducenten niet langer onmogelijk door hen te pesten met klimaatregels. Geef boeren meer ruimte voor het gebruik van dierlijke mest en herzie daarom meteen en zonder uitstel de sterk verouderde nitraatrichtlijn. Onze boeren smeken erom. Het is vijf over twaalf. Boeren smeken om hulp. Help hen.

paragraphs.text: Fru talman! Har ni hört talas om urea? Många européer har inte det. Men urea är ett väldigt viktigt gödningsmedel och viktigt för vår livsmedelsproduktion. Men nu står Europa inför en kris. På grund av leveransproblem i Hormuzsundet, vilket riskerar att göra det dyrare för våra bönder. Men det här beroendet av osäker import, det var förutsägbart.
Europa har egna resurser, men vi har massor av byråkrati, långa tillståndsprocesser och ideologiska beslut som gör oss fortsatt beroende. Vi fortsätter att exportera utsläpp och importera sårbarhet.

Utöver att stärka vårt självförsörjande så borde också gödningsmedel undantas från CBAM. Det fanns med från början, men har strukits ur handlingsplanen. Och det här riskerar att göra det dyrare för våra bönder och för vår mat.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, Monsieur le Commissaire, chers collègues, l'Europe doit sortir de ses contradictions. Alors que nous demandons à nos agriculteurs de produire de manière plus durable, nous laissons s'éteindre à petit feu le secteur de l'élevage, principal fournisseur d'engrais naturels. Alors que l'Europe ouvre ses portes à des produits low-cost qui poussent nos prix agricoles vers le bas, nous taxons les engrais via le CBAM, ce qui fait grimper les coûts de production de nos agriculteurs. Ces incohérences deviennent insupportables et nécessitent des choix politiques courageux.

D'autre part, la directive «Nitrates» a plus de 25 ans. Elle doit être modernisée pour intégrer les innovations agricoles, à commencer par le digestat, issu de la biométhanisation, qui constitue une alternative efficace et durable aux engrais chimiques.
Monsieur le Commissaire, il y a urgence. Ce plan d'action sur les engrais doit être chiffré pour être à la hauteur des défis agricoles, énergétiques et géopolitiques auxquels nous faisons face.

paragraphs.text: Fru talman! EU är ju tyvärr extremt beroende av omvärlden när det gäller konstgödsel, för Sverige så är det ju 100 % beroende av import. Men som vi vet, det finns bönder i Europa som inte drabbas lika hårt av de här skenande priserna av det redan dyra konstgödselet. Det är ekologiska, kretsloppsbaserade, cirkulära, alltså de som helt enkelt inte använder konstgödsel. Jag förstår, och det gör alla i det här rummet, vi kan inte ställa om hela EU:s jordbruk redan i morgon till ekologiskt och hållbart.

Men vi måste ju ändå kunna börja ta ordentliga kliv i den riktningen. Och det här handlar inte bara om pengar och ekonomi. Det handlar om klimatanpassning, jordhälsa, miljöpåverkan från jordbruket och så vidare. Och i förlängningen så stärker ju det här situationen för Europas bönder, inte minst genom att bli mindre sårbara och beroende av omvärlden och fossila bränslen. Ofta så blir jordbruksdebatter någon form av krisdebatt. Den här gången handlar det om gödselfrågan.
Nästa gång, om jag vågar göra en prognos framåt sommaren, så kommer det kanske handla om extremväder och följderna av det för matproduktionen i Europa.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, la strategia sui fertilizzanti presentata oggi è un primo segnale importante e necessario per i nostri agricoltori.
Parliamo di aiuti finanziari, anticipi sulla PAC, nuove regole per il mercato dei concimi biologici e del digestato, misure concrete per dare respiro alle nostre aziende in un momento così difficile.

Oggi più che mai è fondamentale sostenere e rafforzare la produzione europea, perché dobbiamo ridurre le dipendenze dall'estero e incentivare alternative innovative e sostenibili per non essere vulnerabili a ogni crisi geopolitica.

Tuttavia, questo piano non basta: il caro energia e i costi delle materie prime stanno schiacciando le nostre aziende e l'Europa deve reagire se vuole essere credibile. L'agricoltura non va lasciata sola, servono risposte immediate, anche sul piano delle tecniche di evoluzione assistita.
Abbiamo bisogno di scelte rapide e di una visione chiara, capace di garantire prezzi giusti e una maggiore autonomia all'Europa.
Sostenere i nostri agricoltori significa difendere l'Europa, la sua autonomia e la sua capacità di produrre cibo di qualità.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, honourable Members, Commissioner, global crises and energy shocks yet again showed how vulnerable our system really is, because fertiliser production depends heavily on natural gas. Rising energy prices quickly lead to rising fertiliser prices, putting pressure on farmers, food production and consumers. And that is, I think, why this fertiliser plan matters.

The plan aims to bring energy costs down by investing in renewable energy, cleaner technologies and more stable energy supplies. And the idea is very simple: if suppliers and producers can access affordable energy, farmers can access more affordable fertilisers. The plan also supports low carbon and circular fertilisers made from recycled nutrients and renewable hydrogen, reducing dependencies on imported resources. Because that's the biggest problem of Europe.

Fortunately, innovation and sustainability are key to producing EU fertilisers that do not rely on the dominant global suppliers. In the end, this plan is not only about fertilisers, it is about protecting our farmers, stabilising prices, strengthening food security and building a more resilient Europe.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, n'en déplaise aux adeptes de la décroissance qui siègent dans cette assemblée et qui ont tant influencé la Commission européenne, nos agriculteurs ont besoin d'engrais pour assurer notre sécurité alimentaire.

Nous connaissons la crise actuelle, elle est très grave. L'Union européenne porte une immense responsabilité dans la flambée du prix des engrais. Nous avons sanctionné le gaz russe, nous n'avons tiré aucune leçon de la crise de 2022, nous n'avons rien fait pour créer une filière souveraine de production d'engrais.

Et puis, nous avons, à cause de cette religion de la décarbonation, taxé, taxé et taxé. Le fameux CBAM. Je rappelle que mon groupe est le seul à ne pas avoir voté cela. Alors quand j'entends certains collègues aujourd'hui critiquer le CBAM, je les renvoie à leur vote d'il y a quelque temps.

Alors merci, Monsieur le Commissaire, de vous pencher sur ce dossier des engrais, mais vous proposez des mesurettes. Nos agriculteurs nous l'ont dit ce matin devant le Parlement, cela ne suffira pas. Ils ne peuvent même pas acheter actuellement leurs engrais pour les prochaines récoltes.

Alors, nous, nous réclamons la suspension immédiate du CBAM sur les engrais. Nous demandons d'urgence de recréer une filière souveraine de production d'engrais et de développer la filière hydrogène bas-carbone basée sur le nucléaire, afin de sortir des importations de gaz naturel, que nous connaissons bien. Tournons le dos aux idéologies de la décroissance, retrouvons la puissance, aidons nos agriculteurs.

Alors, nous, nous réclamons la suspension immédiate du CBAM sur les engrais. Nous demandons d'urgence de recréer une filière souveraine de production d'engrais et de développer la filière hydrogène bas-carbone basée sur le nucléaire, afin de sortir des importations de gaz naturel, que nous connaissons bien. Tournons le dos aux idéologies de la décroissance, retrouvons la puissance, aidons nos agriculteurs.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, commissaris, het nieuwe actieplan voor meststoffen van de Commissie toont hoe ver Brussel nog van de boerenpraktijk afstaat. We zitten midden in een meststoffencrisis en wat doet de Commissie? Ze weigert de achterhaalde nitraatrichtlijn uit 1991 open te breken. Terwijl de Commissie blijft weigeren miljarden uit CO2-heffing en klimaatgrensbelasting terug te laten vloeien naar boeren of bemestingsfondsen, dwingt ze veehouders in Nederland en België zelfs om hun dierlijke mest af te voeren en tegelijkertijd peperdure kunstmest aan te voeren. Dat is absurd!

Renure en digestaat inzetten is helaas nog niet voldoende. Al anderhalf jaar is een meerderheid van dit Parlement op ons initiatief: meer ruimte voor dierlijke mest en een volledige herziening van de nitraatrichtlijn. De Commissie blijft treuzelen. Wat mist, is boerenverstand. Stop met de jacht op onze veehouderij. Geef boeren ruimte via technologische neutraliteit. Gebruik de circulaire rijkdom die al op ons erf ligt: onze eigen dierlijke mest. Voor onze boeren, voor onze oogsten, voor onze voedselveiligheid.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, the European Union is facing one of the most serious food security challenges in modern times. Nobody doubts this now. The war in Ukraine, instability in the Middle East and rising oil, gas, fuel and fertiliser costs are directly threatening food production across Europe.

Farmers in Ireland, Commissioner, they tell me clearly that the economics of sowing crops simply does not add up at the moment. If farmers cannot afford fertiliser and fuel, food production will inevitably fall and food security will be put at risk.

This is why the European Union must act immediately. We need to reduce and suspend all self‑imposed tariffs, levies and duties on fertiliser imports. These measures have been well intentioned, Commissioner, what you have brought forward today, but food production must come first.

I say to you, Commissioner – and I think you'll get this because you're from a farming background – the problem is not the long term. I think your solutions will work in the long term. The problem is the short term: next winter. Last winter they bought the fertiliser in advance before the CBAM came in. They had stocked up. Now they have a problem. I ask you genuinely to give us solutions which will deliver immediate and practical relief next winter and next spring for our farmers.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, Monsieur le Commissaire, je salue votre volonté de bâtir un plan «Engrais» utile pour les agriculteurs. Flexibilité de la directive «Nitrates», réduction des restrictions aux importations: deux exemples de mesures qui vont dans le bon sens.

Mais ce plan porte malheureusement les cicatrices de blocages et de divisions au sein de la Commission, où certains priorisent une obsession climatique déconnectée du terrain, où d'autres expliquent que suspendre le MACF nuirait aux producteurs européens d'engrais, comme si une industrie pouvait être protégée en faisant disparaître ses premiers clients.

Sans agriculteurs solvables, pas de marché; sans exploitations viables, pas de souveraineté; sans mesures immédiates, les grandes stratégies deviennent de beaux textes posés sur des fermes qui ferment.

Oui, il faut produire davantage en Europe et réduire nos dépendances. Mais ce ne sont pas de futurs corridors commerciaux d'engrais verts, aussi vertueux soient-ils sur le papier, qui vont permettre aux paysans de passer la prochaine campagne. La suspension du MACF «Engrais» était indispensable pour donner à nos agriculteurs une bouffée d'oxygène maintenant et, malgré votre bonne volonté, ce plan ne la leur apportera pas.

paragraphs.text: Senhora Presidente, Senhor Comissário, temos hoje novamente os agricultores à porta deste Parlamento, e com razão.

Há mais de um mês, quando deflagrou o conflito no Irão, pedimos ações imediatas. Sabíamos todos que a questão não era apenas geopolítica. A verdade é que a Europa está demasiado exposta. A agricultura europeia depende fortemente de fertilizantes importados.

Em Portugal, o preço da ureia duplicou, enquanto na produção de milho há relatos de um aumento de custo superior a 300 euros por hectare. Falar de produção europeia e de fertilizantes é positivo, mas isto não baixa a fatura dos agricultores agora.

Os agricultores não podem esperar pelo futuro. A campanha agrícola não espera. Precisam de apoios e de soluções já. Precisam de financiamento, de instrumentos de crise. Se a política agrícola é comum, a resposta em tempo de crise também tem de ser comum. E tem, Senhor Comissário, de ser rápida.

paragraphs.text: Frau Präsidentin! Was wir heute hier wieder vor unserer Türe erleben, ist geschätzt das zehnte Mal, dass europäische Landwirte hier vor unserem Haus demonstrieren. Sie haben ja völlig recht, wenn man sich die Lage anschaut, sie haben völlig recht! Sie demonstrieren für ihre eigenen Rechte und sie haben es schwer.

Wenn wir heute hier von Pflanzenschutzmitteln sprechen, dann reden wir nicht nur über Landwirtschaft. Wir reden über Energiepreise und wir reden über Versorgungssicherheit, und wir reden darüber, ob EU-Europa seine eigenen Landwirte eigentlich noch ernst nimmt oder ob es sie nur mehr veräppelt. Pflanzenschutz ist energieintensiv: Ist der Gaspreis teuer und der Strompreis teuer, machen die Fabriken zu. Das bedeutet, dass wir uns auf der anderen Seite abhängig machen von Importen.

Genau wie die europäische Energiepolitik haben wir das alles schon einmal teuer bezahlt. Die Kommission verspricht nun einen Aktionsplan – auch das haben wir schon oft gehört in den Tagen. Es wird zu wenig sein, einfach grüne Überschriften zu liefern. Sondern: ehrliche Energiepolitik, stabile Gasversorgung und niedrige Strompreise, weniger Bürokratie und keine ideologische Verteuerung.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, siamo nel bel mezzo di una crisi energetica senza precedenti e per questo è arrivato il momento di abbandonare le ideologie green ed essere pragmatici.

Oggi, il prezzo dei fertilizzanti è fuori controllo e i costi si scaricano sempre sugli agricoltori. È necessario abolire immediatamente ETS e CBAM sui fertilizzanti, ma soprattutto – ed è stata fatta prima un'apertura che apprezziamo – è arrivato il momento di utilizzare subito il digestato agricolo, e non solo attraverso una sperimentazione, perché il digestato non è un problema ambientale, ma una delle soluzioni: vuol dire meno dipendenza dalle importazioni, meno costi per gli agricoltori e un'economia circolare reale.
Non possiamo infatti continuare a parlare di sostenibilità, mentre si blocca – o per ideologia o per burocrazia – uno degli strumenti più efficienti che le nostre campagne stanno già producendo.
È arrivato il momento di chiudere con la pagina disastrosa del Green Deal e sostenere chi rende davvero l'Europa più verde e allo stesso tempo più sovrana.

paragraphs.text: Fru talman! Sol, jord och vatten. Ja, många tror att det är allt som behövs för att producera mat och livsmedel. Men det behövs näring i form av gödning, och det börjar bli rejält dyrt nu. Våra lantbrukare förtjänar bättre än att deras liv, försörjning och framtid avgörs av diktaturer eller populister. Vi är fortfarande för beroende av importerad fossilbaserad gödning.

Ryssland är fortfarande en av de största leverantörerna av ammoniak och kalium. Vi kan inte längre acceptera att vår livsmedelsproduktion är så här sårbar för Ryssland eller alla andra länders nycker. Det är inte bara en lantbruksfråga. Det är en fråga om strategisk motståndskraft och livsmedelssäkerhet. Så var är Europas produktion?

Vi har pratat om den här frågan så länge just nu. Varje dag utan tillräcklig produktion i Europa är ett misslyckande. För att minska beroendet av fossil och importerad gödning, det är inte bara ett val mellan miljö och konkurrenskraft, det är lösningen på båda de problemen. Och det är vad Europas lantbrukare både förtjänar och behöver.

paragraphs.text: Doamnă președintă, domnule comisar, apreciem sincer eforturile dumneavoastră în această direcție, dar Europa nu-și poate permite ca fiecare criză geopolitică să se transforme automat într-o criză pentru fermieri.

În aprilie 2026, prețurile globale ale îngrășămintelor pe bază de azot au fost cu 40 % peste nivelul din decembrie 2025, iar pentru fermieri aceasta nu este o statistică pe hârtie. Este diferența dintre a semăna sau a renunța, dintre a fertiliza corect sau a accepta recolte mai slabe, dintre a rămâne pe piață sau a închide ferma.

Vedem din nou planuri de acțiune, strategii și foi de parcurs ale Comisiei Europene. Pe hârtie, sigur, totul arată bine, dar fermierii nu își fertilizează câmpurile cu strategii, nu își salvează recoltele cu promisiuni pentru 2030. Și în timp ce ne întrebăm cum salvăm industria europeană și cum protejăm fermierii, tot noi adoptăm reguli care împing costurile și mai sus.

Înțelegând și subliniez, înțelegând rațiunea adoptării CBAM-ului, nu putem ignora faptul că acesta a dus azi la creșterea costului îngrășămintelor importate cu peste 10-15 %. Astăzi avem o criză a îngrășămintelor, mâine vom avea costuri de producție imposibil de susținut, poimâine vom avea mai puțină producție. Iar o Europă care nu mai produce nu va fi nici verde, nici competitivă și nici suverană, va fi doar dependentă.

Întrebarea reală este cum protejăm producția europeană astăzi? Realitatea este că mai multe fabrici de îngrășăminte din Europa au fost deja închise sau și-au redus drastic producția. De aceea, consider că în primul rând Comisia Europeană trebuie să își concentreze eforturile pe relansarea acestei industrii strategice înainte ca Europa să devină complet dependentă de importuri.

paragraphs.text: Pani Przewodnicząca! Produkcja nawozów w Unii Europejskiej jest obecnie około 19 % niższa niż w 2019 roku, a ceny nawozów wzrosły o 70 % w ciągu ostatnich dwóch lat. I to wszystko przez Zielony Ład. Płacą za to rolnicy i płacą za to wszyscy konsumenci. A komisja powinna nam tylko odpowiedzieć na pytanie, kto na tym zarobił. Bo na pewno nie rolnicy, którzy teraz protestują pod Parlamentem Europejskim.

Ursula von der Leyen uzależnia Europę od importu w każdej dziedzinie. Ubiera to w słodkie słówka o ekologii, a w praktyce kasuje europejski przemysł i uzależnia rolników od importowanych nawozów. Walczycie z Rosją, a według danych Eurostatu to Rosja odpowiada za około 30% importu nawozów do Unii Europejskiej. Walczycie ze śladem węglowym, a stawiacie na import nawozów zza siedmiu gór i zza siedmiu mórz zamiast wspierać produkcję nawozów tu na miejscu, w Europie.

Część moich przedmówców mówiła o tym, że ETS należy odrzucić, ale przecież to wy głosowaliście za tym, żeby ten ETS wprowadzić. Po prostu robicie z ludzi idiotów. Posłuchajcie rolników, którzy teraz protestują. Odrzućcie Zielony Ład. Odrzućcie CBAM i odrzućcie podatek ETS. Jeżeli tego nie zrobicie, prędzej czy później zostaniecie rozliczeni.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, ça urge. Le renouvellement des contrats de livraison de fertilisants pour le reste de l’année et la campagne 2027 est devenue un vrai casse-tête. Pour ce qui est du plus long terme, des réponses plus robustes seront indispensables pour réduire la vulnérabilité de l’Union européenne en la matière, et pas seulement dans le domaine des fertilisants dont dépend l’Europe. Pour le dire clairement, en matière de dépendance structurelle de l’agriculture européenne, j’aimerais recourir à deux métaphores. En ce qui concerne les matières azotées, dont le soja, les vaches européennes broutent dans les plaines du Río de la Plata. Et par ailleurs, ce qui fait pousser nos céréales se trouve dans le sous-sol des déserts du Moyen-Orient, notamment.

Consciente qu’il importe de travailler sur la sécurité de l’approvisionnement à long terme, la Commission pourrait-elle me préciser comment elle entend utiliser le Global Gateway pour sécuriser nos livraisons d’engrais, tant que nous ne sommes pas à même de les produire nous-mêmes? Quant au développement des capacités de production de fertilisants dans l’Union européenne, c’est toute notre politique d’industrialisation que nous devons repenser face à des États-Unis qui ne veulent plus de nous et à une Chine qui veut nous étouffer au plan industriel.
Ce qui nous laisse de l'espoir, c'est ce que nous dit le commissaire à l'agriculture.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, Monsieur le Commissaire, la question des engrais est devenue un sujet stratégique majeur pour l'Europe, car derrière les engrais, il y a notre souveraineté alimentaire, notre indépendance énergétique et l'avenir de notre agriculture. Les tensions au Moyen-Orient et le blocage du détroit d'Ormuz nous rappellent une vérité très simple: la dépendance, c'est la vulnérabilité. En 2022, la flambée des prix des engrais a failli faire plier des exploitations entières. Ce sont les mêmes agriculteurs qui subissent aujourd'hui les conséquences d'une dépendance que vous avez vous-même choisie.

Des solutions concrètes existent. Les méthaniseurs permettent de valoriser les résidus agricoles pour produire du digestat, un fertilisant local et renouvelable. Quelques entreprises européennes résistent encore. Elles maintiennent une filière engrais malgré la hausse des coûts et une réglementation qui décourage davantage qu'elle ne soutient. Préservons-les et renforçons-les, car si elles disparaissent, nous n'aurons plus rien à sauver.

Mais l'Europe accumule les erreurs: Farm to Fork a fragilisé notre production sans alternative viable, le Mercosur ouvre nos marchés à des productions qui ne respectent ni nos normes ni nos exigences environnementales. La Commission le reconnaît elle-même en créant des omnibus pour corriger ses propres erreurs. Sur le nucléaire, elle a fini par admettre qu'elle en avait besoin. Dans dix ans, faudra-t-il un omnibus agricole pour réparer les erreurs commises aujourd'hui avec la PAC et les engrais?

paragraphs.text: Madam President, Commissioner, this plan will be judged by one test. Will it lower fertiliser costs and secure availability for farmers? The geopolitical crisis in the Middle East has put our gas and fertiliser dependence into the spotlight once again. And while it may not be the defining crisis in agriculture today or tomorrow, plans for 2027 could be put into major jeopardy if fertiliser prices do not come down and supply is further disrupted.

But perhaps the bigger elephant in the room is the looming CBAM tax. This is something entirely within the Commission's control. Waiting until the end of this year to assess the impact of CBAM on agricultural commodity prices will be too late. So flexibility on state aid, emergency measures, boosting domestic production are all very welcome. But would the Commission be open to suspending CBAM if and when this crisis deepens? We need commitment in long‑term financing, because simply making advance payments while cutting the next CAP will not work.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, Commissioner, thanks a lot, such a proposed fertiliser plan is a very good one. But of course, we need to discuss not only strategic plans, but also how we can address and react to this crisis because the situation is very unusual.

And of course, fertilisers should also be excluded from sanctions, like water, like food. You have no chance to sanction water, to sanction food or to sanction medicine. Fertilisers belong to the same goods. They are strategic ones. We need to find ways of how we can solve problems, keeping in mind targeted sanctions, but not sanctioning fertilisers as such.

Of course, it would also be good to discuss issues about state aid now. In Lithuania, we have two big factories that are producing ammonium and phosphates, but we need to also address issues because the situation is urgent. We need urgent action plans.

paragraphs.text: Arvoisa puhemies, ilman lannoitteita ei ole ruokaa. Siihen kiteytyy lannoitteiden merkitys maailmalle.

Kun tarkastellaan euroja, maatalouden kustannuksista lannoitteet ovat yksittäisenä kustannuksena suurin. Tähän puolestaan kiteytyy lannoitteiden hinnan merkitys ruuantuottajille. Jos emme turvaa lannoitteiden saantia ja kohtuuhintaisuutta, emme hallitse ruokapöytäämme.

Kaikesta tästä huolimatta Eurooppa on kehittänyt itselleen lannoiteriippuvuuden. Olemme riippuvaisia tuonnista, enkä tarkoita nyt, että olisimme riippuvaisia Norjan kaltaisesta maasta. Me olemme lannoitteissa olleet riippuvaisia Venäjästä.

Tätäkö on eurooppalainen omavaraisuus? Se, mikä meille on elintärkeää, tulisi pitää omissa käsissämme. Tarvitsemme enemmän omaa lannoitetuotantoa. Ruokapöytiimme ei tule tarjoilla enää yhden yhtä uutta riippuvuutta.
Euroopan on viimein opittava ruokkimaan itse itsensä.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, Commissioner, farming is in crisis, as you well know and there is a significant challenge with regard to sustainability of farming. We speak regularly about intergenerational solidarity and the need to bring new young people into farming. And of course, at the heart of it is the fact that input costs have increased dramatically in recent years – the price of fuel and most importantly, the price of fertiliser. And that is having a profound impact on profitability and on farming practices and crop rotation. But equally, on top of that, this is now going to fall into consumers right across the globe in terms of food inflation.

So, the short term obligations are on us to address immediately and that would be the issue of the suspension of CBAM, the emissions trading scheme and any other areas of policy that are putting burdens and cost on fertiliser in the short term. In the medium term, we obviously have to expand our own internal capacity to ensure that we have adequate fertiliser. And of course, the longer term is to address the whole issue of the types of fertiliser we use. But in the short term, Commissioner, the plan you have outlined is welcomed, but we do have to suspend anything that puts additional costs on the price of fertiliser to farmers and increasing food prices for consumers.

paragraphs.text: Κυρία Πρόεδρε, ενώ έχουν γίνει νέες, εκρηκτικές αυξήσεις έως και 50% στα κατά βάση εισαγόμενα λιπάσματα μέσα σε λίγους μήνες, εξαιτίας του ιμπεριαλιστικού πολέμου στη Μέση Ανατολή, με την τιμή τους να είναι σχεδόν τριπλάσια από το 2022, η Επιτροπή με τις κυβερνήσεις τώρα «πουλούν φύκια για μεταξωτές κορδέλες». Κρύβουν σκόπιμα ότι «κάνουν πλάτες» στις ΗΠΑ, στο Ισραήλ, στο πολεμικό σφαγείο στη Μέση Ανατολή αλλά και στην Ουκρανία. Η πολιτική της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης επέβαλε εξοντωτικούς δασμούς στα ρωσικά λιπάσματα και τις ρωσικές πρώτες ύλες, για να γεμίσουν μετά τα ταμεία των αμερικανικών μονοπωλίων με το πανάκριβο αμερικανικό LNG. Είναι η ΚΓΠ της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης που σφίγγει σαν θηλιά τους βιοπαλαιστές αγροτοκτηνοτρόφους με πανάκριβο κόστος παραγωγής και εξευτελιστικές τιμές στα προϊόντα τους, για να θησαυρίζουν τα μονοπώλια και να στραγγίζεται ο λαός. Καμιά θυσία για τα κέρδη και τους πολέμους των ιμπεριαλιστών που οδηγούν σε εκτόξευση τιμών και υπολίπανση αγρών. Οι αγρότες με τον αγώνα τους απαιτούν την κατάργηση του ΦΠΑ, την επιβολή πλαφόν στις τιμές, την επίταξη αγροεφοδίων, αφορολόγητο πετρέλαιο και εγγυημένες τιμές.

paragraphs.text: Poštovana predsjedavajuća, poštovani povjereniče, pozdravljam akcijski plan, kratkoročne i dugoročne mjere.

Jasno je što, prije svega, kratkoročne mjere donose. Treba se ublažiti trenutni pritisak na poljoprivrednike, spriječiti nestašica ili nagli rast cijena. Međutim, voljela bih da odgovorite kada će države članice zapravo dobiti taj informativni paket, odnosno ciljani paket koji ste najavili. Netko je već danas spomenuo generacijsku obnovu, prošloga tjedna imali smo u Hrvatskoj izbor za najboljeg mladog poljoprivrednika 11. godinu zaredom i, dakle, ta generacijska obnova nužna nam je, međutim, ono što oni poručuju, jest da nisu potpore same po sebi dovoljne i ako one nemaju stabilnost i predvidljivost, tako da vas molim da razmislite o tome. Teško je planirati sjetvu, teško je planirati ulaganja i proizvodnju kada ne znate koliki će vam biti troškovi.

U svakom slučaju, ono što jest zajednički nazivnik, ja mislim svim političkim skupinama, jest zaštititi proizvodnju i prehrambenu sigurnost u Europi jer to nije samo pitanje poljoprivrede, ono je pitanje i naše strateške autonomije.

U svakom slučaju, ono što jest zajednički nazivnik, ja mislim svim političkim skupinama, jest zaštititi proizvodnju i prehrambenu sigurnost u Europi jer to nije samo pitanje poljoprivrede, ono je pitanje i naše strateške autonomije.

paragraphs.text: Pani Przewodnicząca! Szanowni Państwo! Rolnictwo musi być konkurencyjne. Aby było konkurencyjne, ceny nawozów muszą być niższe, a zakłady azotowe muszą produkować taniej. Aby tak było, muszą spaść ceny gazu. Gaz jest podstawowym surowcem do produkcji nawozów azotowych. Ale gaz to nie tylko główny składnik związany z ceną nawozów. Na to składa się także ETS i CBAM. Konieczne jest zawieszenie CBAM-u. Konieczne jest zawieszenie ETS-u. Ale tu, na tej sali słyszałam wielokrotnie prorosyjską narrację. To właśnie Rosja przez lata uzależniała Europę, Polskę od gazu, od ropy, od węgla. Dziś ci politycy chodzą tu, w Parlamencie Europejskim i krytykują politykę Unii Europejskiej. Może uczciwiej byłoby, jakby przestali zarabiać w euro, a zaczęli zarabiać w rublach. Ale z nawozami musimy coś koniecznie zrobić.

interventions.speaker_role_in_transcript: Member of the Commission

paragraphs.text: Madam President, honourable Members, I would like to conclude by thanking you, first of all, for all your valuable contributions today and maybe highlight a few points that you have raised as well.

I would first mention what Elsi Katainen has said about the decision that our farmers are about to make. I spoke recently to a French farmer. He has 400 hectares and he said that if the situation remains like it is, he will not plant half of his fields. That would lead us, if many do the same, to a situation where, unfortunately, our food security would be at risk, even if it is with the higher costs. I think that is the situation we all have to avoid together.

I have heard your proposals and questions very clearly on the affordability for farmers, the predictability for the producers, the concrete support, the ETS, digestates, on CBAM and on Europe's strategic dependencies. You do not agree on all the points, but I would like to say a few things when it comes, for example, to the diversification of our supply chains. Already before this crisis and before this fertiliser action plan, we reduced the MFN duties from other third countries like Trinidad, Tobago and others in order to bring down the prices and to diversify our suppliers.

I have also noted the question on the Global Gateway by Mr Goerens and I would like to link this by the question from Ms Toussaint on the cadmium content. I think we have possibilities in the Global Gateway, for example, to help reduce the cadmium content too, which is in the interest of our health, our consumers' health, but which can also create partnerships with new, better and more sustainable suppliers. I think this has to be used and there is, of course, the possibility.

Our proposals of today will help us to also sharpen the implementation. So, the fertiliser action plan is a practical framework for action now and a strategic agenda for the years ahead. In the short term, we will mobilise targeted financial support. Mr Sargiacomo and Mr Köhler asked what money we are speaking about. I can tell you that the money is already what we have left in the agricultural reserve. This is a little bit more than EUR 200 million. So, this is all in and I believe we can at least double this amount. This will, of course, also depend on the budgetary authority. So, it will depend on the Parliament and the Member States if we indeed reach this doubling at least. So, there you are in the boat to help us as well.

Then we also have the liquidity tools, the CAP flexibility, the state aid possibilities, better advice on nutrient management and practical solutions for digestates with the appropriate safeguards. In the longer term, we will strengthen domestic production, support the bio‑based and low‑carbon fertilisers, and improve the single market for inorganic fertilisers.

On CBAM, I could hear that there was the discussion one way or the other. You have to know that we import around 40 % of our fertilisers and 60 % is our domestic production. When you speak to the fertiliser industry, if we would suspend the CBAM, this would be prolonging their unfair competition with third countries. There would be more closures like the one Ms Grapini mentioned, for example, in Romania, but there have also been other examples. Of course, this is damaging our sovereignty even more in the long term and I think that needs to be avoided. At the same time, the additional costs coming in by CBAM have to be compensated in one way or another and that is what we are working on.

Then on the ETS, the forthcoming review will also be an important opportunity to support the industrial decarbonisation, including in the fertiliser value chain, while also keeping Europe's production capacity and farmers' needs firmly in view. The EU fertilisers value chain partnership will help us turn this approach into a concrete policy dialogue between the farmers, producers and the Member States.

Some of the changes ahead will require legislation and I also count on this House to work with us constructively as well as swiftly. Our farmers also deserve these swift replies. Above all, it is about Europe's farmers, about our fertiliser producers, food affordability and food security for all our citizens. So, I am counting on a good cooperation to realise the measures that we have presented and discuss the practical details.

paragraphs.text: Dan-Ştefan Motreanu (PPE), în scrisComisia Europeană recunoaște gravitatea crizei îngrășămintelor și îmi exprim sprijinul pentru acest Plan de acțiune. Este un pas necesar pentru a proteja securitatea alimentară a Europei, pentru a sprijini fermierii afectați de costurile ridicate și pentru a reduce dependența strategică a Uniunii de importuri. Fermierii europeni au însă nevoie de mai mult decât un semnal politic. Au nevoie de măsuri concrete, rapide și substanțiale: sprijin financiar imediat din rezerva agricolă, scheme de lichiditate, flexibilitate pentru plățile în avans și instrumente reale care să reducă presiunea costurilor înainte de următorul sezon agricol. În același timp, trebuie să reconstruim capacitatea de producție europeană. România cunoaște foarte bine această vulnerabilitate. Cazul Azomureș arată cât de riscant este ca Europa să piardă producători strategici tocmai într-un context de volatilitate și incertitudine. Avem nevoie de un cadru competitiv care să permită producătorilor europeni să investească, să producă și să contribuie la consolidarea autonomiei strategice a Uniunii. Solicit, de asemenea, măsuri temporare pragmatice: mai multă flexibilitate în aplicarea Directivei Nitrați și suspendarea temporară a tarifelor vamale pentru importurile de îngrășăminte esențiale din țări terțe, cu excepția Rusiei și Belarusului.

paragraphs.text: Cristian Terheş (ECR), în scrisComisia Europeană vine din nou cu un plan de acțiune pentru o criză – cea a îngrășămintelor acum – pe care tot ea a provocat-o prin ani de politici verzi ideologice absurde și decizii rupte de realitatea economică. Comisia recunoaște că energia este principalul cost al industriei, dar nu propune o schimbare reală a politicilor energetice care au făcut energia europeană mult mai scumpă decât în SUA sau Asia. Pactul Verde a crescut artificial prețul gazului în Europa, însă documentul continuă logica acestui pact și a decarbonizării accelerate, deși chiar Comisia admite că aceste obiective "ambițioase" necesită investiții uriașe și cresc costurile industriei. Se insistă în continuare pe "tranziția verde", pe fertilizanți "low-carbon", pe eco-scheme și pe condiționalități climatice, ceea ce înseamnă mai multă birocrație și costuri suplimentare pentru fermieri. Planul recunoaște că UE a pierdut capacități de producție și că există risc de dezindustrializare, dar evită să admită că politicile climatice și costurile reglementărilor europene au contribuit direct la această situație. Pe scurt, Comisia recunoaște că există o problemă, însă nu doar că refuză să admită cauza, dar insistă să continue și mai "ambițios" cu măsurile care au provocat actuala criză. Numai niște birocrați iresponsabili pot crede că făcând și mai "ambițios" același lucru pot genera rezultate diferite.

paragraphs.text: Ивайло Вълчев (ECR), в писмена формаУважаеми колеги,Представения план за действие в областта на торовете има няколко положителни страни, които биха помогнали на европейските земеделски производители да се справят с нарастващите предизвикателства пред сектора. Усилията за намаляване на зависимостта на Европейския съюз от вносни суровини и за по-добро използване на ресурсите, които вече съществуват в европейското земеделие са добро начало, но са недостатъчни.Европейските фермери продължават да са изправени пред високи производствени разходи, скъпа енергия и все по-силна конкуренция от трети държави. Не можем да говорим за конкурентоспособно земеделие, ако европейските политики водят до допълнително оскъпяване на производството без адекватни компенсаторни механизми. Само ви припомням, че преди няколко месеца огромни протести на земеделците бяха под прозорците ни.Време да се предприемат конкретни действия по прилагането на механизма за корекция на въглеродните емисии на границата (CBAM) и на Схемата за търговия с емисии (ETS) по отношение на торовете. Днес не можем да продължаваме да увеличаваме техните разходи, докато нашите предприятия са притиснати от високите цени на енергията, политическата нестабилност и загубата на конкурентоспособност.Земеделските производители се нуждаят от по-силни и незабавни решения. И ние сме отговорните за това да намерим тези решения.

paragraphs.text: L'ordine del giorno reca il tempo delle interrogazioni alla Vicepresidente della Commissione/Alta rappresentante dell'Unione per gli affari esteri e la politica di sicurezza - Strategia dell'UE per affrontare l'attuale crisi in Medio Oriente.

La durata prevista per il tempo delle interrogazioni, come sapete, è di 60 minuti. Avete a disposizione 1 minuto per formulare un'interrogazione e 2 minuti per la risposta. Per il primo turno di oratori sarà possibile porre un'interrogazione supplementare di 30 secondi con altri 2 minuti per la risposta. Vi ricordo che l'eventuale interrogazione supplementare è concessa soltanto se è correlata strettamente all'interrogazione principale e non consiste in una nuova interrogazione. Chi intende formulare l'interrogazione è invitato a registrarsi fin da ora, utilizzando la funzione "catch the eye" sul dispositivo di voto.

Stanno già arrivando le richieste. Siete stati velocissimi. Dopo aver inserito appunto la tessera, durante il tempo delle interrogazioni, i deputati interverranno dal proprio scranno. Invito tutti gli oratori a rispettare il tempo di parola assegnato. I deputati potrebbero aver bisogno di alcuni minuti per registrare la loro richiesta e per porre l'interrogazione tramite il dispositivo di voto. E quindi vi chiedo, per coloro che non l'hanno fatto, ma mi pare l'abbiano già fatto tutti, di presentare la richiesta.

paragraphs.text: Good day everybody, thank you very much for your questions. I have not made the proposal of suspension of the association agreement. We did the analysis on the basis of the association agreement with Israel and that analysis came to the conclusion that Israel is breaching human rights under this association agreement. But there is no support for the suspension of the association agreement.

When it comes to the Board of Peace, reading the charter of this Board of Peace, it is impossible to join that Board of Peace, because the Board of Peace that was foreseen in the United Nations Security Council Resolution was considered to be for Palestine, it was considered to be temporary and it had a clear pathway for Palestinian ownership in the end. It is not in the current Board of Peace and it does not respect also the equality of states principle that we usually have when joining international organisations.

paragraphs.text: Señora presidente, señora Kallas, el Consejo Europeo designó formalmente en febrero al Cuerpo de los Guardianes de la Revolución Islámica como organización terrorista, por fin. Sin embargo, desde 2016 la Unión Europea ha gastado más de 124 millones de euros en operaciones, según se dice, humanitarias sobre territorio controlado directamente por este mismo régimen iraní, que ha demostrado sus crímenes asesinando a decenas de miles de sus compatriotas.

Hamás, Hizbolá, los huzíes, todos son instrumentos de una misma arquitectura de desestabilización dirigida desde Teherán que hoy bloquea el estrecho de Ormuz y con ello amenaza el suministro energético de Europa. Mientras tanto, hay Gobiernos europeos, como el de Pedro Sánchez, que no solo se niegan, como otros, a apoyar a Estados Unidos, sino que se han alineado directamente con los enemigos contra nuestros principales aliados. Hasta han rechazado ampliar el mandato de misiones como Aspides en el golfo de Adén, invocando una inexistente desescalada frente a un régimen que la Unión Europea acaba de catalogar como terrorista.
¿Qué vamos a hacer respecto a estos miembros de la Unión Europea que se portan así en situaciones de crisis?

paragraphs.text: Thank you for your question. To be very clear, we are not supporting any terrorist organisations. And yes, it's true that we have designated the Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation. So to be very clear, we are supporting giving humanitarian aid to help the people in different countries and, of course, also trying to help civil society in different countries.

Now, the other question you had, I mean, my remit is external policy, not different Member States and their policies, and Member States have different approaches to different questions. So if your question was about our operations in the region, then yes, we have operations, with EUBAM Rafah managing the border crossing point between Egypt and Gaza. We have also EUPOL COPPS that is ready to train Palestinian policemen, but we don't have authorisation from the Israeli side so we can also help with building up the justice reform.

Then we have also naval operations, when it comes to Operation Aspides, for example, where different Member States are also participating, and that is dealing with the freedom of navigation, escorting the ships, and the whole of the mandate is actually covering also the Strait of Hormuz. The operational plan is not covering it. So if we want to extend that, then we need to change the operational plan. But it is true that we are active in the region.

Me refiero concretamente al Gobierno socialista de España.

paragraphs.text: Dear Commissioner Kallas, the European Union's response to the crisis in the Middle East has too often projected hesitation, instead of leadership. Diplomacy without power, as you know, is merely empty words.
So the first question that I have for you is: how is the EU engaging to help the United States and Israel defuse the situation and make sure that the Iranian people will be free again?

The second question: the situation in the Middle East affected all the transit corridors in the region, mainly the Strait of Hormuz. Now more and more Europeans are realising the importance of the 'Middle Corridor'. But if the EU is not engaging with Georgia, and Azerbaijan just refuses recently to engage any more with the European Parliament, how are we going to ship stuff from Central Asia to Europe?

Last but not least, I am sure you are aware that in the UNRWA schools many of the books used there are using materials that incite hatred towards Jews. Many of these books are printed with EU money. What is the European Commission doing to make sure that these books are not printed with such materials in the future?

interventions.speaker_role_in_transcript: Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy

paragraphs.text: A lot of questions, different questions. So, first, the crisis in the Middle East. It is true that diplomacy without hard power, military power, is much weaker than with this military power. And that is why, actually, we are doing more for our own defence, increasing defence expenditure so that we can be not only an economic power but also a military power. We are using the tools in our toolbox as an economic power to influence things. We are in constant contact with the Gulf countries, with the regional partners, also Pakistan, which is part of these discussions, to see how we can contribute.

When it comes to Iran, we have the expertise in negotiating the nuclear issue, for example. We have the experts, we have also offered these experts to negotiate on the nuclear issue – and not only the nuclear issue, we also have other issues that concern Iran. You mentioned the difficult situation of the people in Iran. We have seen executions going up since 2024. It is 68 %, actually, the increase in executions. We see that people who are protesting against the war are also being targeted. So of course we can't speak about everything publicly, but we are also supporting civil society in Iran.

When it comes to Central Asia, I totally agree with you that we need to work with them to also have the diversification of trade routes. I think everybody has learned from this not to put all eggs in one basket, and we have a Central Asia ministerial that we are actually currently organising. We had that last year, especially about the transport corridors and things that we can do together in order to have a different approach or different trade routes that we can use in times of crisis.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Haute Représentante, il y aurait beaucoup à dire dans ce débat. D'abord sur la responsabilité écrasante du régime iranien et de ses vassaux dans l'embrasement du Moyen-Orient, mais aussi sur l'absence flagrante de stratégie américaine et sur notre impuissance européenne. Tout cela est tristement vrai.

Mais je voudrais vous parler d'autres victimes de la situation actuelle, qui sont présentes dans la région depuis 2 000 ans, qui ne menacent personne, mais à qui on s'en prend sans cesse. Je voudrais vous parler du sort des chrétiens au Liban et en Terre sainte: aujourd'hui, une religieuse française attaquée en pleine rue; le quartier arménien, témoin d'humiliations et de harcèlements à répétition, à Jérusalem, la ville du tombeau du Christ; des prêtres, des moines, des portails d'église sur lesqules on crache; des villages chrétiens rasés au Sud-Liban, des populations déplacées, des crucifix vandalisés.
De quel droit? Dans quel but? Qui peut croire que la lutte légitime contre le Hezbollah passe par l'humiliation gratuite des chrétiens en Orient? Et que fait l'Union européenne ?

paragraphs.text: I agree with you that freedom of religion is one of the underlying principles. That's why what we see also in Israel, what we see in different parts – humiliating, like you say, the religious customs of different religions – and that is unacceptable. That's very clear. Of course, we are also raising these issues with our Israeli counterparts and our counterparts from different countries where these things are happening.

Antisemitism is a big issue that we are also seeing. We are opposing any provocation and unilateral attempts to change the status quo of East Jerusalem, especially its old city and the sacred spaces for everybody. This is what we are condemning: the harassment and anti-Christian aggression in Jerusalem.

That is what we do. We have the tool in our hands, which is condemning these acts. We are not present on the ground so that we can actually defend. But this is, of course, what you can also do: voice and say that this is unacceptable. I think that's also quite powerful coming from this House.

paragraphs.text: You know very well how Europe functions. We have put measures from the Commission on the table for the Council to decide. Some of them require qualified majority and we don't even have a qualified majority for that. Some require anonymity and we don't have unanimity either. So that's where we are now.

When it comes to the suspension of the Association Agreement, that needs everybody's agreement. And we don't have that. We just simply even couldn't have a qualified majority. My question is always 'would it actually make the situation better?' It will definitely close our channels to talk to the Israelis, and that I'm doing all the time. Yes, you can say that raising these issues is not really delivering results, because it's not. I mean the situation is not better, but would it better were we to stop this?

When it comes to capital punishment, of course, we were voicing also what we think about this, but then we also need to treat all our partners in the same way, because we have a list of countries that we have association agreements with. Many of them actually have capital punishment, and many of them are also executing people. So we should also look into these association agreements if we are, you know, to suspend the one with Israel. But there is no willingness from the Member States' side. It's not a one person decision. It's not even a Commission decision. It's a European Council decision. And all the Member States need to be on board. Of course, I'm not giving you the list of these Member States because it's not good practice. So we have the confidentiality of our discussions as well. But, you know, it's clear that not everybody is on board.

I had a meeting with the European defence ministers; I had a meeting with the European foreign ministers. I was really calling. We have the European operation already in the region. It has a mandate. The only thing it needs is change in operational plan. So, not much, if everybody agrees. And we can use it immediately. Of course, all the Member States want to use it when conditions allow. But right now, the problem with this operation is that it has too few ships.

Now, what I've been telling the ministers is that separately all of us are small and weak, because one has one ship, the other has one ship. But if we put it together in our Operation ASPIDES, then we are actually a credible force, then nobody can say that Europe is weak because together we are strong.

The other thing is that if we are right now trying to strengthen our cooperation with the Gulf countries, then this Operation ASPIDES could also be a credible security provider in the region, if we do this together. Now there is a French-UK initiative. We can also contribute via Operation ASPIDES to this mission that is also engaging countries from outside Europe. My point is: let's do these things together, because if we look at the geopolitical picture, we need to be united in this.

So these people are also afraid.

But we have the tools when it comes to economic sanctions. And regimes also change when it is weak enough so that the power structures, like the army and police, actually change course; they are not repressing the people anymore because they don't get the salaries or whatever because of the sanctions. That's why these tools also work.

paragraphs.text: Dear Ms Kallas, since you took office as High Representative, the Middle East has undergone a complete transformation: the fall of the Bashar al-Assad regime in Syria, the genocide in Gaza, alongside the Israeli occupation of the West Bank, the violent settlers – all of this contradicting our two-state position, violence in Lebanon between Hezbollah that is destroying the country, and also Israel, which is destroying the country, occupying it and displacing a lot of people, and the war against Iran – that has a consequence. That consequence was until now attached to the Gulf countries and global economic crisis. We are all against the militias in the Middle East, but certainly we cannot support any military intervention without the backing of international law.

So, I would like to ask you for concrete issues. When will the EU Middle East strategy will be published? What specific policies will you launch related to upholding international law? How will the Gaza Facility operate? As far as we know, UNRWA has not yet received EU funding alternatives following the end of the UNIFIL. And will you work to activate blocking statute to protect our European judges investigating war crimes in the region? We just knew how they withdraw the sanctions against Francesca Albanese in the US.

But we have been engaging with the Gulf partners, really, and it's actually in their interest as well that we are part of the security architecture of the region – because what everybody agrees is that the security architecture will be completely different after this war is over. And clearly, the Gulf partners have also seen that we are reliable, credible allies, and we need to be part of the future build-up as well.

Now, of course, when it comes to the international justice system, why is it so important that it's held up? It's because of the accountability. Again, when we talk about the war in in Ukraine, when we talk about Gaza, when we talk about all these wars, then people also need to see accountability. People in the West Bank, for example, if they see that their family has been killed, their homes have been destroyed, they need to see somebody held accountable. That's why the justice system is extremely, extremely important. It's also very important for us, and to have long-term peace, because if there is accountability, there is less revenge and retaliation that keeps on happening in this region.

If you can, just repeat your questions in the follow-up, because I couldn't take it all down.

It's very important because our ICC judges are the ones who are fighting against the impunity of the Israeli Government and to hold them accountable for what they have done in Gaza and Lebanon.

paragraphs.text: Gospa predsednica, spoštovana visoka predstavnica. Evropa še naprej se skriva za diplomatskimi besedami. Verjetno se z menoj strinjate, ko še na terenu umirajo nedolžni civilisti. Vojni zločinci ostajajo nekaznovani. Izraelski apartheid briše palestinski narod in bombardira Libanon.

EU ne more biti svetovni mirovnik in posrednik, če uporablja dvojna merila – tista, ki so v Afriki, v Aziji, v Evropi in drugod po svetu. Če želimo ohraniti moralni kompas, se moramo odločno postaviti na stran pravice. Kljub temu da je predsednica Komisije Ursula von der Leyen razglasila, da je tradicionalni sistem, temelječ na pravilih, končan in se EU ne more več zanašati na ta sistem.

Spoštovana visoka predstavnica, kaj nam ostane, če ne mednarodno pravo? Kaj nam ostane še, če ne bomo sprejeli sankcij proti Izraelu? Kam bo Izrael še nadaljeval s konflikti? In v kolikor mi tega ne bomo naredili, potem se bodo zgodbe nadaljevale na Bližnjem vzhodu, v Afriki, v Aziji, v Evropi. Spoštovana, rekli ste, da nimate vzvodov, ampak dajte predlog na mizo, da se bo jasno videlo, katere države članice ne podpirajo sodelovanja z izraelsko republiko oziroma državo.

paragraphs.text: The international order is under heavy strain. That's very clear. We see international law being breached every day. And now the question is 'how do we approach this'? When we look back in history, the League of Nations was established so there wouldn't be any wars. And it didn't fail because the principles were wrong. It actually failed because the founders of this organisation didn't keep to those principles. So the United Nations was established with the UN Charter, and the UN Charter is actually very clear. I think everybody agrees to that. But again, I come back to my previous point, when I answered your colleague, that it lacks accountability.

So I think also that in the times we are living in now, we have to use it in order to develop international law further and to also have, you know, accountability so that nobody feels that they are above the law. Because if you just start wars and nothing happens to you, you just, you know, send soldiers to kill other soldiers or, you know, brothers, fathers and sons of one country to kill other fathers, brothers and sons of another country and nothing happens to you, then you know other aggressors will learn the lesson.

I see a lot of appetite for Europe when I go across the world, they are saying that you are the only ones who are actually standing up for international law right now, so we are also willing to align with you when you are developing this further, and we need to use that. When it comes to the proposals, the proposals are on the table, but we have counted and we don't have the votes. So is it better that we put it to the vote? So everybody sees that we are divided, when we know that we are?

paragraphs.text: The oppression of the Iranian people is undeniable. Their desperate plea for help in the face of overwhelming brutality from the Islamic regime is also undeniable.
An entire people have been cut off from the internet for months, silencing the voices. In this internet blackout, they are intimidated, imprisoned and executed. This is an actual open‑air prison.

The EU's reaction has been disgraceful. Instead of helping liberate the people and getting rid of the Islamic regime, Europe has decided to take the path of weakness. European leaders want to get back to diplomacy with these fanatics even if that condemns the Iranian people to live under oppression forever.
My question to the High‑Representative Kaja Kallas is: how do you see that the EU's diplomatic approach towards the regime has concretely helped the oppressed Iranians?
